payload.summary: Saved answers keep the support label they were stored with, so the 'Strong support' label rule does not apply to answers cached before it shipped
payload.detail: Found in PR B review 2026-09-25 (#WGMB4Z, owner decisions 3, 10 and 17). The label cap (strongSupportLabelCapped) is computed on the server when the answer is projected for the client, and the client payload carries only the boolean, not supportedClaims or evidenceAssessments, so the browser cannot recompute it. A stored payload without the field keeps main behaviour (not capped). The restored answer thread (src/lib/answer-thread-storage.ts, sessionStorage, 12-hour TTL) replays the stored payload, so an answer saved before the rule shipped can still read 'Strong support' after deploy, in the same tab, for up to 12 hours. Server-side cached answers are re-projected on every response, so they pick up the rule (read from the answer routes, not tested). Not checked: whether any other store (saved or exported answers) keeps a client payload. Likely fix: bump the stored-thread schema version when a trust or label rule changes so older threads are discarded, and pin it with a test in tests/answer-thread-storage.test.ts.
